title: Embedded Workforce Architecture, Identity & Coverage Closure
objective: Make the Titan Zero workforce a first-class part of the system architecture rather than a layer added after features are built. Every roadmap goal/sub-goal that addresses a business, customer, workforce, operational, financial, growth, compliance, communication, decision or exception pain must explicitly identify the canonical agent(s) that own the outcome, reuse/extend an existing agent or create and register a new named agent as part of that same implementation. Goal 41 owns the workforce identity schema, hierarchy/delegation rules, pain/outcome design standard, cross-roadmap registration and anti-duplication controls, then performs an end-of-roadmap coverage scan to discover missing pain points and add new roadmap work until material pain/outcome gaps are closed. The 16 mandatory innovative pain-point capabilities are exemplars of the required design quality, not a separate innovation layer.

goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.
embedded_workforce_rule: Agents are built into the roadmap work that solves the pain they own. A feature, engine, workflow or domain capability that materially addresses business pain must not be completed first and later wrapped by an agent. The owning canonical agent identity and outcome boundary are defined/reused as part of the same sub-goal, and the agent uses the relevant engines/tools through governed execution.

workforce_impact_decision.no_agent_rule: NO_AGENT_INFRASTRUCTURE_ONLY is valid only where the work is genuinely infrastructure/control-plane/platform plumbing with no distinct business pain/outcome owner; a reason must be recorded.

agent_identity_rule: Every canonical workforce agent has one permanent agent_id independent of display name, host, surface, plan or vertical projection. Names/aliases may evolve but agent_id, lineage, ownership boundary and registry history remain traceable.

agent_design_standard.rule: Every workforce agent must reach equivalent problem/outcome specificity and operational depth; it must not merely reproduce a conventional job title. The exemplars define quality, not identical function.
minimum_definition: unprompted noticing conditions where class permits
success metrics and attributable business value

coverage_closure_rule: After agents have been created/extended throughout the roadmap, perform a whole-business pain-point coverage scan across customer journeys, worker journeys, operational lifecycles, financial/value leakage, exceptions, risk/compliance, growth, supply, communication and cross-team coordination. Every material uncovered pain point must be mapped to an existing agent or converted into new roadmap sub-goal/goal work with a named owning agent. Repeat until the remaining uncovered items are explicitly accepted as non-material, out-of-scope or human-only.
mvp_scope_note: P0 establishes first-class agent identity, the mandatory workforce-impact declaration for roadmap work, hierarchy/delegation rules, the universal pain-point design standard and the embedded-agent lifecycle. Full donor convergence, surface compilation and end-of-roadmap missing-pain closure continue as P1.
agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Canonical workforce identities/hierarchy may be defined here, but identities must remain domain/outcome based and surface-neutral.
